751-1849-3286.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1981-2415-7192-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1981-2415-7192-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2921-4772-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2921-4772-5254.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

728-967-3809-4365-7087.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1308-4365-6753-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3375-3641-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Distinguished Conjurer trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Distinguished Conjurer trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-3641-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

670-1619-1734-6143.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-1734-6143.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Feywild Caretaker.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, it triggers, returning Feywild Caretaker from exile to the battlefield.
When Feywild Caretaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Feywild Caretaker trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Feywild Caretaker.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Fiend Hunter.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-2819-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Goblin Goliath, adding {C}{C}.
When Goblin Goliath dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Goblin Goliath from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Goblin Goliath enters, it triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-2292-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

13-140-7433.description:
Activate Selenia by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast a copy of Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

717-2034-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex and Bone Miser trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1558-1671-3875-4231-5184.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Xorn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

851-1563-2079-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

141-4050-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-4050-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-4050-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

5670-6705-6823.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
5670-6705-6823.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1379-1978-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Forests.
1379-1978-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Rofellos.
Repeat

2034-2043-3000-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {2}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

101-313-1777.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Vampire Charmseeker, adding {B}{B} and then an amount of additional {B} and/or {R} equal to its mana value minus 2.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Vampire Charmseeker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3689-4659-6263.description:
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {3}.
Mendicant Core triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy the Workshop Assistant spell, creating a token copy of it.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning another artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the token Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}.
When the token Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning the nontoken Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1437-5013.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
1437-5013.description:
Cast Bloom Hulk by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Bloom Hulk spell three times.
Resolve the first Bloom Hulk spell.
When the Bloom Hulk token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.
1437-5013.notes: This combo results in infinite copies of the Bloom Hulk spell on the stack, which you can then resolve to infinitely proliferate. This can put infinite indestructible counters on Myojin to infinitely copy any permanent spell(s) you cast in the future.

1742-2232-5659.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nontoken nonartifact Lhurgoyf.
You have at least one nonartifact Lhurgoyf creature card in hand.
1742-2232-5659.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a nonartifact Lhurgoyf card, adding {B}.
Disa the Restless' first ability triggers, putting the discarded Lhurgoyf from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When the Lhurgoyf enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another nontoken nonartifact Lhurgoyf from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

618-1827-2240.notablePrerequisites:
Conspicuous Snoop does not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is at least three.
618-1827-2240.description:
Cast Vampiric Tutor by paying {B}, causing you to lose 2 life and search your library for Kiki-Jiki and put it on top of your library.
Activate Conspicuous Snoop using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of Conspicuous Snoop with haste.
Repeat step 2 using the Conspicuous Snoop token.

2020-2633-3940.notablePrerequisites: Vadrik has a power of at least three.
2020-2633-3940.description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {R}.
Urabrask and Haze of Rage's storm ability triggers.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and adding {R}.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, copying Haze of Rage for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve all Haze of Rages, giving creatures you control +1/+0 until end of turn for each Haze of Rage, and returning the original Haze of Rage to your hand.
Repeat.

628-4050-5296.description:
Activate Workhorse by removing all +1/+1 counters, adding that many {C}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Workhorse, adding one mana of any color.
Workhorse undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

739-937-3859.description:
During your upkeep, activate Cavern Harpy by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Resolve the last Cavern Harpy trigger, returning it to your hand.
The remaining Cavern Harpy triggers fizzle.
Activate Magus of the Mirror by tapping and sacrificing it, exchanging your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
